requirementSummary: When a user selects a Condenser Type and a Refrigerant, the Unit Type dropdown must be populated with options filtered by the selected Condenser Type and Refrigerant. After a Unit Type is selected, the Unit Size dropdown must be populated with options filtered by the selected Refrigerant and Unit Type.
businessRules: If a user selects a Condenser Type and a Refrigerant, the system must populate the Unit Type dropdown with entries from SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant filtered by the selected Condenser Type and Refrigerant.

If a user selects a Unit Type (after selecting Condenser Type and Refrigerant), the system must populate the Unit Size dropdown with entries from SDCommonUnitModelSizes filtered by the selected Refrigerant and Unit Type.
The Refrigerant list is obtained via a GET request to the unitdesign API endpoint /dropdowns.
Filtering of Unit Type entries uses the "parent" array of each SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant item to match the selected Refrigerant (and Condenser Type as required).
Filtering of Unit Size entries uses the "parent" array of each SDCommonUnitModelSizes item to match both the selected Refrigerant and the selected Unit Type.
developerConsiderations: Call the unitdesign API GET /dropdowns to retrieve SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant and SDCommonUnitModelSizes data.
When filtering Unit Type options, include items whose parent array contains the selected Refrigerant (and apply any required Condenser Type logic as defined by the data model).
When filtering Unit Size options, include items whose parent array contains both the selected Refrigerant and the selected Unit Type.
Update the Unit Type and Unit Size dropdowns dynamically in the UI whenever the relevant selections change.
ambiguities: How the selected Condenser Type should be used to filter Unit Type entries, given the example parent arrays only contain refrigerants.
What should be displayed or how the UI should behave when no entries match the filter criteria.
The exact structure, pagination, and error handling of the /dropdowns API response is not defined.

ambiguityResolutions.ambiguity: Unclear if Unit Size filtering should also consider Condenser Type in addition to Refrigerant and Unit Type.
ambiguityResolutions.rationale: The ticket explicitly states that Unit Size filtering is based on Refrigerant + Unit Type only, so Condenser Type is not part of that filter.
ambiguityResolutions.sourceQuote: When we select the Unit Type, we should see the Unit Size dropdown filtered by Refrigerant + Unit Type selected.

ambiguityResolutions.ambiguity: It is unclear whether the isActive flag must always be enforced or if inactive items can ever be shown.
ambiguityResolutions.rationale: The ticket provides example data containing an "isActive" field but does not specify any rule for using it; therefore no policy can be inferred.
